hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For every pair of characters present in the string, their frequencies must differ by at most k.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: If the minimum frequency among retained characters is f, any character with frequency < f must be completely deleted, and any frequency > f + k must be reduced to f + k.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate over each existing frequency as candidate minimum f. Calculate total deletions and take the minimum across candidates.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Character counting followed by trying at most 26 frequency baselines.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all possible character deletions is exponential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the optimal baseline minimum frequency must match one of the original frequencies.
